provenance.note: The negatives are minimal reproductions of the rule's exclusions, offsets and the legitimate shapes observed in the mainline replay; the positives are mutation controls for the boundary assertions the rule exists to surface. This JSON is the CI-replayed regression surface for the recorded live-fire measurement, not a second independent measurement. mainline_pairs_touching_eligible_source counts pairs touching a file inside the detector's own scope (non-declaration, non-generated/vendored, non-test JS/TS).
provenance.recomputed_by: .github/workflows/cast-growth-evidence.yml (fetches the pinned heads and replays cast-growth-fires.mjs; cast-growth-verify.mjs fails on any divergence from this record or the committed fire records)
